description: On demand, runs a long-living shell that prints READY once and then TICK every 100ms forever; exercises the /start-sensor → /tail-sensor → /stop-sensor pipeline in CI. Regulates the harness's own behaviour by ensuring blocking-sensor lifecycle works end-to-end. The READY line is the 'up' marker the watcher loop waits for; TICK lines prove the streaming path keeps producing individual Signals while the sensor is running. Auto-detected via /detect-sensors as a smoke fixture for the blocking-sensor CI path.

execution.command: echo READY; while true; do echo TICK; sleep 0.1; done

name: Smoke blocking — READY+TICK loop

golden_cases.notes: Replay shows READY plus three TICKs; both patterns match pass/info, exit_code_map['*'] = pass/info on graceful stop.
